lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 158-160 included in the PDF)
location_note: Western slope of the Mount of Olives near the Moriah Observatory; general map ref. NIG 22310/63142, OIG 17310/13142 (English summary: NIG 223100/631420).
notes: Damaged burial caves: Cave 3 (kokhim, troughs, wooden coffin nails; later arcosolia Chamber E with cross) and Cave 4 (three halls, kokhim, ossuary chamber with seven ossuaries, nine ossuaries in all, inscribed Shoshana, Sarah, Levi; unfinished arcosolia) built in the Second Temple period and reused in the Byzantine period; Cave 2 ('Cave of the Crosses') Byzantine. The PDF's summary pages also carry the end of the Ramat Sharet summary and the start of the Nahalat Ahim summary (other units); not used here.

features.subtype: kokhim burial caves with troughs, ossuary chamber (nine ossuaries), later arcosolia
features.period: built in the late Second Temple period (juglet late 1st c. BCE-70 CE, 1st-c. CE glass); reused in the Byzantine period
features.quote: point to its construction in the Second Temple period

features.subtype: arcosolia cave with two chambers and painted crosses ('Cave of the Crosses')
features.quote: the crosses point to a date in the Byzantine period
